# ESP Online Tester

> A browser-based ESP32 product workbench for coding agents and people. Configure supported devices and accessories, run firmware in a local WebAssembly worker, inspect real guest output, and share or embed scenes. Also known as ESP Workbench / 产品实验台.

This fork is maintained by Zhu Zhe (zhuzhe1983) and builds on mikroverk/esp32sim. The two skills below describe different workflows: operating the existing platform, and contributing product adaptations in a repository checkout. Firmware compatibility and peripherals vary by product; catalog presence and a rendered 3D model do not establish working firmware or physical hardware validation.

## Skills

- [esp-online-tester](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/skill/SKILL.md): Configure scenes, load firmware, exercise inputs, verify serial/framebuffer output, record and replay interactions, and embed the workbench. Start here when developing or testing firmware for an existing supported product.
- [esp-product-onboarding](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/onboarding-skill/SKILL.md): Add or update products, accessories, manufacturer CAD and photo textures, sourced hardware knowledge, firmware catalogs and verification evidence. Requires a repository checkout; contributions use pull requests.

## Platform and references

- [Agent guide and maintainer](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/agents.md): Choose a skill, get its complete directory, understand the workflow and find the maintainer.
- [Live workbench](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/): Human interface and window.espTester automation API; firmware runs in the browser.
- [Runtime API](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/skill/references/api.md): Implemented commands, capabilities, observations and iframe RPC.
- [Agent workflows](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/skill/references/agent-workflows.md): Unattended tests, failure diagnosis, audio and network boundaries.
- [Scene configuration and catalogs](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/skill/references/configuration.md): Public catalog contributions and private DIY definitions.
- [3D model verification](https://zhuzhe1983.github.io/esp-online-tester/platform/onboarding-skill/references/model-verification.md): CAD, dimensions, photo overlays, textures and provenance.

## Project and maintainer

- [Zhu Zhe / zhuzhe1983](https://github.com/zhuzhe1983): Maintainer of this fork; public GitHub profile and other repositories.
- [ESP Online Tester source](https://github.com/zhuzhe1983/esp-online-tester): Source code, issues, contribution history and both skill directories.
- [Upstream esp32sim](https://github.com/mikroverk/esp32sim): The original emulator project on which this fork is based.
